Name: Cold Weather Haley
Author: bingbongsingalong
Description:
This mod changes Haley's portrait and character sheet to a new outfit.

Includes cold weather files and vanilla files so you can switch between seasons.

And if any brilliant modder knows how to use SMAPI or whatever to make clothes change during seasons, feel free to use and edit my mod however you like (no credit necessary).

Downloads.Description: Includes mod and vanilla so you can switch between seasons.
